easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Lagrella, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Lagrella until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
